item.title: Synthetic everything is distorting American politics
item.description: A polling firm admitted to fabricating survey results in two key races, calling it a short-term social experiment.

item.title: Syria and Israel seek to ease tensions after airbase strike
item.description: High-level officials from Israel and Syria met on Sunday to reduce tensions following a recent airbase bombing, according to reports.

item.title: Democrats expand Senate battleground into GOP strongholds
item.description: With ten weeks until Election Day, the Senate race map is widening, reaching into traditionally Republican areas, a shift from typical midterm patterns.

item.title: Texas governor warns AI data centers face consequences
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott issued a strong warning to the AI industry, saying data centers have 'dug their own grave' in an interview with ABC's Jonathan Karl.
